name: SSX family member 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SSX1 encodes protein SSX1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and spermatogenesis.
